notes.random: It is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. #8 was picked from the cb_bbkc_ym_v4_15m finalists using its 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, consistency across periods) as well as 2018–2022, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice (the grid itself was fixed before any YM 2023–2024 squeeze result). The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First squeeze-breakout look at the YM holdout. No compression-breakout strategy had been scored on YM 2025 onward before this. Only #8, frozen beforehand, was run (also scored by the funnel's final-test the same day), so there's no selection among holdout results. The mean-reversion family was scored on YM 2025+ earlier (a different strategy), so the researcher has seen how that period treated it.
